en:
Corrected information

The viral video is a deepfake. 

Original footage is from 27 October 2023, when then Maj Gen Girish Kalia (GOC 28 Infantry Division) was briefing in Kupwara, Jammu & Kashmir about Pakistani infiltration attempts across the Line of Control. He reported that 10 attempts were foiled, 27 terrorists were eliminated, and warlike stores + narcotics were recovered. He made no statements about China, Arunachal Pradesh, Asaphila, Longju, Taksing, denial of supplies, or deploying forces against local youth.[](<>)

The circulating version has digitally altered/fabricated audio overlaid on the old footage. Indian Army fact-check accounts and independent analysis have confirmed this. The claims that Lt Gen Kalia “admitted” Chinese control of those areas are false.[](<https://t.co/pxxpCGJL5R>)
Actual border situation (as of late October 2026)
Face-offs between Indian and Chinese troops have continued at multiple locations along the Arunachal Pradesh border. ITBP Director General Shatrujeet Kapur publicly confirmed this.[](<https://t.co/eG11b7RNnu>)
A specific stand-off has been ongoing since late July 2026 near Asaphila / Taksing (Upper Subansiri district). Chinese PLA troops reportedly pitched tents roughly 6–7 km within India’s perception of the LAC near the Maja company operating base.
India has increased its deployment. Corps Commander-level talks were held in the Eastern Sector in September 2026.
Claims of full Chinese “control” of entire Asaphila, Longju, and Taksing circles are exaggerated and not supported by official statements. These are contested areas with differing perceptions of the LAC, not confirmed occupation of the circles as claimed in the deepfake.

---
Suggested tweet (factual, clear, and shareable)

```
🚨 DEEPFAKE ALERT

A manipulated video falsely claims Lt Gen Girish Kalia said China has taken control of Asaphila, Longju & Taksing in Arunachal Pradesh.

Fact: Original video is from 27 Oct 2023 — then Maj Gen Kalia was briefing in Kupwara (J&K) on Pakistani LoC infiltrations (10 attempts foiled, 27 terrorists eliminated). Audio was digitally altered.

There ARE ongoing face-offs with Chinese troops at multiple points in Arunachal (confirmed by ITBP DG), including a stand-off near Taksing since July. But the viral claims of “control” and the officer’s alleged statements are fake.

Verify before sharing.
#FactCheck #Deepfake
```

You can copy-paste and post this (or tweak the tone if you prefer it shorter/more concise). Let me know if you want a shorter version, Hindi version, or any changes.
